h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thrissur

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thrissur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Thrissur

c: Thrissur's open grounds fill up for the Pooram, and the rest of the year its parks and school grounds are used by walkers, players and families. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Thrissur for those grounds, and for colleges, church and temple trusts, residential associations and corporate campuses. We build the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,050 km away, and send it to Kerala by road.

Central Kerala gets very heavy rain in the southwest monsoon, and laterite soil turns soft and red when soaked. Both affect how we plan the base. We ask for photos and measurements, suggest machines for your users and send a layout drawing. Our team or a dealer in south India installs once you approve. For associations with limited funds, we can plan a first phase and leave room on the drawing for later machines.

richText.heading: A firm base on laterite soil

c: Laterite drains reasonably well but erodes around posts if water runs across it. A concrete pad with grouted posts and an edge drain stops this. Rubber flooring on top gives a firm, clean surface when the ground around is muddy.

items.q: Is laterite ground suitable for outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Yes, with a concrete pad and grouted posts. An edge drain stops rainwater eroding the soil around the base during the monsoon.

items.q: Can a church or temple trust buy an open gym?
items.a: Yes. Trusts and community bodies often set up a few machines on their grounds for members and neighbours. We plan the layout around existing paths and gathering areas.

items.q: Do the machines rust in Kerala's rain?
items.a: The frames are galvanised pipe and many parts are roto-moulded plastic, so they resist rust. Wipe them after heavy rain and keep the base drained.
